parameters.inputs: (ait_product_subscription/any(s: s/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{variables('Subscriber')?['ait_subscriberid']}) or ait_pack_product/any(p: p/ait_isactive eq true and p/ait_pack_subscription/any(s: s/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{variables('Subscriber')?['ait_subscriberid']})))

parameters.where: @and(equals(item()?['kind'], 'product'), or(equals(item()?['name'], items('Each_token')), equals(item()?['alt'], items('Each_token')), contains(item()?['aliases'], concat(',', items('Each_token'), ','))))

parameters.inputs: @if(greater(length(body('Pack_hit')), 0), first(body('Pack_hit')), if(greater(length(body('Exact_hit')), 0), first(body('Exact_hit')), if(equals(length(body('Contains_hit')), 1), first(body('Contains_hit')), json(concat('{"kind":"', if(greater(length(body('Contains_hit')), 1), 'ambiguous', 'none'), '"}')))))

parameters.select: @if(equals(item()?['kind'], 'pack'), concat('ait_pack_product/any(p: p/ait_packid eq ', item()?['id'], ')'), concat('ait_productid eq ', item()?['id']))

parameters.$filter: ait_isactive eq true and (@{outputs('Followed_condition')}@{if(empty(body('New_conditions')), '', concat(' or ', join(body('New_conditions'), ' or ')))})

inputs: @{if(outputs('Over_cap'), concat('Not added: that would bring you to ', length(body('Count_after')?['value']), ' products, and the limit is ', outputs('Cap'), '. Remove some with /remove first, or add fewer.'), if(empty(body('New_labels')), '', concat('Added: ', join(body('New_labels'), ', '), '.')))}
@{if(empty(variables('Unmatched')), '', concat('No match for ''', join(variables('Unmatched'), ''', '''), '''. Try /products ', first(variables('Unmatched')), ' to search the catalog.'))}
@{if(empty(variables('Ambiguous')), '', concat('More than one product matches ''', join(variables('Ambiguous'), ''', '''), '''. Pick one below.'))}
@{concat('You follow ', length(body('Count_now')?['value']), ' products. Type /mysubs to see them.')}
